grants.title: Authorization grants
grants.subtitle: A declaration asks here; approving is the only thing that grants. Nothing runs without an active row, and a scope exclusion always wins.
grants.requests.help: Declaring a domain asks; approving here is the only thing that grants. Approve it as asked, or widen the scope to the parent subtree or the zone — those are different permissions, not a default.
grants.empty.filtered.title: No grant matches these filters
grants.empty.filtered.hint: Clear the filters to see the whole ledger.
grants.empty.none.title: No grants yet
grants.empty.none.hint: A grant is permission to run one capability against specific targets, for a window. Nothing runs without it.
grants.list.help: who may run what, against which targets, and until when. Exclusions win over every row here.
grants.capability.passive_discovery: read public data — DNS records, certificates
grants.capability.vulnerability_analysis: run a scanner against the target
grants.issue.title: Issue a grant
grants.issue.searchPlaceholder: search your assets, or type a value
grants.issue.pickHint: Pick from the list or type one and press Enter. Patterns work:
grants.issue.levelHint: a level is a bundle of capabilities; the list below is what it actually grants
grants.issue.justificationPlaceholder: why this target and this window
grants.issue.selfAuthorized: Invasive capabilities cannot be self-authorized: the backend will refuse this.
grants.issue.targetRequired: Pick a target above — a grant with no target permits nothing.
grants.issue.principalRequired: Name who runs it (the principal the collector will act as).
grants.issue.issuerRequired: Name who issues it. Invasive capabilities cannot be self-authorized.
grants.issue.windowInvalid: The window has to be between 1 and 8760 hours.
grants.issue.justificationRequired: Write why — the audit trail keeps this sentence.
grants.simulate.title: Check a decision
grants.simulate.hint: One question, nothing touched: may this principal run this capability against this target, with this tool and environment? The same engine the collectors call.
grants.simulate.targetRequired: Give a target value to evaluate.
grants.review.title: Review the request
grants.review.hintRest: what is listed below; widening the scope is a different decision and is written as one.
grants.review.apexBefore: A wildcard never covers its own apex, so a subtree is always the host
grants.review.capabilities: What may be done with it
grants.review.levelFallback: a level bundles capabilities; the engine still decides each one.
grants.review.duration: For how long, and who answers for it
grants.review.actorRequired: Name who approves: the audit trail keeps the identity.
grants.review.forbidden: Only an administrator can approve a request. {message}
grants.review.rejected: rejected {targets} — the domain stays in the inventory, unauthorized
grants.reject.title: Reject the request
grants.reject.body: {targets} stays in the inventory and stays unauthorized. The requester reads this reason.
grants.reject.reasonRequired: A reason is required: a rejection is audited.
grants.revoke.title: Revoke grant
grants.revoke.body: {principal} loses {capabilities} immediately. The grant stays in the ledger as revoked, with who revoked it and why.
grants.revoke.reasonRequired: A reason is required: revocation is audited.
members.title: Members and access
members.accounts.title: accounts (login users)
members.accounts.empty: No accounts yet — bootstrap the first owner from Settings.
members.invitations.title: invitations
members.invitations.empty: No invitations. Create one to add a teammate without setting a password for them.
members.invite.singleUse: Single-use link — the previous one stops working.
members.named.title: named members (audit attribution)
members.ledger.title: audit ledger
audit.title: Audit trail
audit.empty: No audit entries for these filters.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.center.title: Notification center
notifications.center.empty.title: No notifications
notifications.center.empty.hint: Notifications appear here when events occur (SLA breaches, assignments, retest requests, etc.).
notifications.prefs.title: Notification preferences
notifications.channels.title: Delivery channels
notifications.channels.help: A channel hears what you subscribe it to: SLA breaches, and the new advisories the daily clock finds on your builds. Slack expects an incoming-webhook URL; webhooks receive a signed JSON envelope.
notifications.channels.name: Name
notifications.channels.col.name: name
notifications.channels.empty.title: No channel yet
notifications.channels.empty.hint: Slack: create an incoming webhook in the Slack app and paste its URL here.
setup.title: Set up Barad-dûr
setup.subtitle: The ordered path from an empty organization to a working pipeline.
setup.subtitleLive: Six steps, in this order. Each one unlocks the next — this page reads live data, so it also works as a status check.
setup.progress.done: Everything is wired. Review the dashboard for posture and the audit trail for changes.
setup.progress.label: setup progress
setup.step.scope.label: Scope
setup.step.scope.title: Define what belongs in scope
setup.step.scope.hint: Add domains, repositories, IPs and exclusions first. Connecting an integration never starts a scan automatically.
setup.step.projects.label: Projects
setup.step.projects.title: Organize applications
setup.step.projects.hint: Relate code and infrastructure to each application. Add repositories you explicitly choose to bring into Barad-dûr.
setup.step.assets.label: Assets
setup.step.assets.title: Add business context
setup.step.assets.hint: Add owners, environments and criticality to the assets that make up each application before interpreting risk.
setup.step.grants.label: Authorization
setup.step.grants.title: Authorize analysis
setup.step.grants.hint: Grants are a control before active work, not the product entry point. Set targets, tools, workers and permissions deliberately.
setup.step.findings.label: Findings
setup.step.findings.title: Run analysis and manage results
setup.step.findings.hint: Launch analysis only when you are ready, then triage findings with owners, priority and remediation deadlines.
setup.step.cycles.label: Cycles
setup.step.cycles.title: Create cycles when you need them
setup.step.cycles.hint: Start a CTEM cycle or pentest campaign when its scope, ownership and evidence need a bounded operating rhythm.
